project.name: hearthmail
project.description: Hearthmail is a cross-platform (macOS first) email client for any IMAP/SMTP account with a private AI assistant that runs entirely on local Ollama models: smart inbox sorting, summaries, reply drafting, natural-language and semantic search, translation, plus local organization like snoozes, VIPs, send later and follow-ups.

nodes.name: Accounts & Mail Sync
nodes.summary: Connects any IMAP/SMTP account (Google or Microsoft OAuth with PKCE, or an app password with provider presets and autodiscovery), keeps credentials in the keychain, and keeps a merged multi-account inbox fresh. Handles paging, opening full message bodies and server-side message actions.

businessRules: Secrets (app passwords, OAuth tokens) live only in the keychain; account configs are stored without secrets
New credentials are verified with a live connect before the account is saved
Operations on one account are serialized and transparently reconnect after a connection loss
Inbox pages are 40 messages, newest first; refresh only prepends unseen UIDs
Opening an unread message marks it read on the server
crossDomainInteractions: Every new batch of mail is handed to Local Organization rules and to the semantic index (Search)
New mail triggers AI inbox sorting when auto-sort is on
Provides the SMTP transport used by Composing & Sending

nodes.name: Add Account with Google/Microsoft Sign-In
nodes.summary: Signs the user in through the browser with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE and adds the account using XOAUTH2 for IMAP/SMTP.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks 'Sign in with Google/Microsoft' on the account setup page

nodes.name: Save OAuth client ID
nodes.summary: Stores the user's own Google or Microsoft OAuth client ID/secret in settings if not yet configured.

nodes.name: Run browser PKCE sign-in
nodes.summary: Binds a loopback server, opens the consent page, receives the authorization code and exchanges it for tokens.

nodes.name: Read identity from ID token
nodes.summary: Decodes the ID token claims to learn the account email and display name.

nodes.name: Verify IMAP/SMTP connection
nodes.summary: Tests the new credentials by connecting to the provider's servers before saving.

nodes.name: Store token and account
nodes.summary: Writes the OAuth token to the keychain and persists the account config.

nodes.name: Connect the new account
nodes.summary: Adds the account session, replacing any old one with the same address, and connects it.

nodes.name: Add Account with App Password
nodes.summary: Adds any IMAP/SMTP account using an app password, auto-filling server settings from presets or Mozilla autodiscovery.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User fills the password form on the account setup page

nodes.name: Match provider preset
nodes.summary: On each email keystroke, matches a known provider preset and pre-fills hosts and ports.

nodes.name: Discover server settings
nodes.summary: For unknown domains, queries autodiscovery to find IMAP/SMTP hosts.

nodes.name: Validate form and test login
nodes.summary: Validates the form and verifies the credentials with a live connection.

nodes.name: Store password in keychain
nodes.summary: Saves the app password to the keychain and the account config to preferences.

nodes.name: Add and connect account
nodes.summary: Registers the account session and connects it.

nodes.name: Connect Account and Load Inbox
nodes.summary: At startup or reconnect, connects each account, lists folders and loads the first inbox page.

domainMeta.entryPoint: App startup (AppState.init) or a manual reconnect

nodes.name: Start app and housekeeping
nodes.summary: Opens user data, refreshes the local AI and starts the 30-second housekeeping timer.

nodes.name: Load credentials
nodes.summary: Loads the account's password or OAuth token from the keychain, refreshing the token if needed.

nodes.name: Connect to IMAP
nodes.summary: Creates the MailService, connects and opens the account's triage cache.

nodes.name: List mailboxes
nodes.summary: Lists folders in a friendly order and picks the inbox.

nodes.name: Fetch first inbox page
nodes.summary: Fetches the newest 40 inbox messages and tags them with their account and folder.

nodes.name: Run post-fetch pipeline
nodes.summary: Learns contacts, applies local rules and indexes the new messages.

nodes.name: Refresh Inbox
nodes.summary: Fetches the newest mail for every account, prepends new messages and kicks off sorting and indexing.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User refreshes, or a quiet background refresh

nodes.name: Fetch latest pages
nodes.summary: Fetches the newest inbox page per account and retries failed accounts quietly.

nodes.name: Prepend unseen messages
nodes.summary: Keeps only UIDs not already loaded and prepends them to the inbox.

nodes.name: Process new mail
nodes.summary: Runs contact learning, block/mute rules and semantic indexing on the fresh messages.

nodes.name: Trigger AI sorting and indexing
nodes.summary: Starts AI inbox sorting (when auto-sort is on) and background semantic indexing.

nodes.name: Open Message and Act on It
nodes.summary: Opens a message, downloads its full body, marks it read, and runs server actions like archive, delete, flag, junk or move.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User selects a message in the list or uses the toolbar/context menu

nodes.name: Select message
nodes.summary: Selects the message in the reading pane.

nodes.name: Download full body
nodes.summary: Fetches the full MIME message if only headers were loaded.

nodes.name: Mark as read
nodes.summary: Marks the opened message as seen on the server.

nodes.name: Run message action
nodes.summary: Runs read/flag/delete/archive/junk/move through a shared runner that updates the visible lists.

nodes.name: Apply on server
nodes.summary: Performs the IMAP operation, e.g. archive to the Archive folder or Gmail's All Mail.

nodes.name: AI Triage & Smart Inbox
nodes.summary: Runs a private local AI (Ollama) that sorts the inbox into categories and priorities, flags needs-reply and suspicious mail, and produces 'Catch me up' briefings. Results are cached per account so each email is sorted once.

businessRules: All AI runs locally through Ollama; no mail leaves the machine
Each email is triaged once; results are cached per account and trimmed to the newest 5000
Sorting is newest first in batches of 10 using schema-constrained JSON
Only one sort runs at a time; a request during sorting queues one re-run
crossDomainInteractions: Triggered by Accounts & Mail Sync when new mail arrives
Its suspicious flag feeds the phishing warning in Reading & AI Assistance
Supplies the shared EmailAi facade used by Search, Reading and Composing

nodes.name: Connect Local AI Models
nodes.summary: Connects to the Ollama server, lists installed models and picks defaults for the assistant.

domainMeta.entryPoint: App startup or saving AI settings

nodes.name: Save AI settings
nodes.summary: Persists the Ollama URL and model choices and refreshes AI when they change.

nodes.name: Create Ollama provider
nodes.summary: Recreates the OllamaProvider from settings.

nodes.name: List installed models
nodes.summary: Calls /api/tags to list installed models with a short timeout.

nodes.name: Pick default model
nodes.summary: Picks a default chat model by parameter size when none is chosen.

nodes.name: Build EmailAi facade
nodes.summary: Constructs the EmailAi facade with the fast, writing, translation and embedding models.

nodes.name: Sort Inboxes with AI
nodes.summary: Collects untriaged inbox messages and has the local model categorize and prioritize them.

domainMeta.entryPoint: New mail arrives with auto-sort on, or user clicks re-sort

nodes.name: Collect untriaged messages
nodes.summary: Gathers inbox messages across accounts that are not in the triage cache, newest first.

nodes.name: Convert to EmailContent
nodes.summary: Converts each MimeMessage into the protocol-independent EmailContent.

nodes.name: Triage a batch with the model
nodes.summary: Sends batches of 10 emails in one JSON-schema-constrained call for category, priority, needs-reply and suspicious.

nodes.name: Cache triage results
nodes.summary: Stores results in the per-account triage cache, trimming to the newest 5000.

nodes.name: Report progress
nodes.summary: Updates sorting progress and handles AI errors with a toast.

nodes.name: Catch Me Up Digest
nodes.summary: Streams a Markdown briefing of up to 30 unread inbox emails.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks 'Catch me up'

nodes.name: Pick unread mail
nodes.summary: Picks up to 30 unread inbox messages for the briefing.

nodes.name: Stream digest
nodes.summary: Streams a Markdown briefing grouped by importance from the local model.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Finds mail across accounts using three cooperating strategies: server-side keyword search, AI natural-language planning and re-ranking, and a local semantic vector index. Results can be answered by the AI ('Ask AI').

businessRules: Keyword search lists exact matches first, then up to 10 related semantic matches scoring at least 0.4
AI search widens by dropping keywords when nothing matches
AI results fuse server and semantic matches with reciprocal rank fusion before the model re-ranks the top 30
Vectors are truncated to 512 dimensions and L2-normalized; the index is per account and per embedding model
crossDomainInteractions: Uses the EmailAi facade from AI Triage & Smart Inbox to plan, rank and answer
Uses MailService (Accounts & Mail Sync) for server searches
New mail from Accounts & Mail Sync is embedded into the index

nodes.name: Keyword Search
nodes.summary: Runs a server-side keyword search and appends closely related semantic matches.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User types in the search bar with AI off

nodes.name: Choose search targets
nodes.summary: Searches the open folder or each account's All Mail folder.

nodes.name: Build keyword plan
nodes.summary: Builds a SearchPlan from the query words.

nodes.name: Run server search
nodes.summary: Runs IMAP SEARCH (or Gmail raw search) per account.

nodes.name: Find semantic matches
nodes.summary: Embeds the query and scores the local vector index in parallel.

nodes.name: Merge results
nodes.summary: Lists keyword matches first, then up to 10 related matches by meaning.

nodes.name: AI Natural-Language Search
nodes.summary: Turns a question into structured filters, searches, fuses with semantic matches and re-ranks with the local model.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User asks a question with AI search on

nodes.name: Plan search with AI
nodes.summary: Converts the question into a SearchPlan (sender, dates, keywords, flags).

nodes.name: Translate plan to server query
nodes.summary: Converts the plan into IMAP SEARCH criteria or Gmail syntax.

nodes.name: Run and widen
nodes.summary: Runs the search per account and drops keywords if nothing matched.

nodes.name: Fuse with semantic matches
nodes.summary: Combines server and semantic matches with reciprocal rank fusion.

nodes.name: Re-rank with AI
nodes.summary: Asks the model to order the top 30 candidates by relevance.

nodes.name: Answer from results
nodes.summary: Optionally streams a short answer from the top 6 results ('Ask AI').

nodes.name: Build Semantic Index
nodes.summary: Embeds mail into a per-account local vector index in the background.

domainMeta.entryPoint: New mail arrives, startup, or user rebuilds the index

nodes.name: Start background indexing
nodes.summary: Indexes every connected account, coalescing overlapping requests.

nodes.name: Open vector index
nodes.summary: Lazily opens the account's index file for the current embedding model.

nodes.name: Walk All Mail and Sent
nodes.summary: Pages back through All Mail and Sent to find unindexed messages.

nodes.name: Embed in chunks
nodes.summary: Embeds unindexed messages in chunks of 16 through Ollama /api/embed.

nodes.name: Add normalized vectors
nodes.summary: Truncates and normalizes each vector and stores it.

nodes.name: Save index
nodes.summary: Evicts the oldest entries beyond the limit and writes the binary file.

nodes.name: Reading & AI Assistance
nodes.summary: Renders emails safely and adds local AI help on the open message: summaries, quick replies, translation, calendar event extraction and phishing warnings.

businessRules: Email HTML is sanitized with a strict Content-Security-Policy; only a nonce-authorized fit script runs
Remote images are blocked by default
Translation is offered only when the detected language differs from the user's
A sender is flagged suspicious when the display name impersonates another address, or when the AI triage marks it suspicious
crossDomainInteractions: Uses EmailAi from AI Triage & Smart Inbox
Quick replies open the composer in Composing & Sending
Shows unsubscribe and snooze controls from Local Organization

nodes.name: Render Email Safely
nodes.summary: Turns a raw HTML or plain-text body into a sandboxed page and shows warnings.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User opens a message

nodes.name: Check for phishing
nodes.summary: Combines the sender-impersonation heuristic with the AI's suspicious flag to show a warning.

nodes.name: Sanitize HTML
nodes.summary: Removes executable/navigating elements, blocks remote images and adds the CSP.

nodes.name: Fold quoted history
nodes.summary: Collapses quoted replies from common mail clients.

nodes.name: Wrap plain text
nodes.summary: Converts plain-text mail into linkified HTML with quote styling.

nodes.name: Show in web view
nodes.summary: Renders the document in a locked-down platform web view.

nodes.name: Summarize and Quick Reply
nodes.summary: Streams a summary of the open email and offers three short AI replies.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks Summarize or Quick replies in the AI bar

nodes.name: Prepare email content
nodes.summary: Converts the message to EmailContent for prompting.

nodes.name: Stream summary
nodes.summary: Streams a Markdown summary with TL;DR and action items.

nodes.name: Suggest quick replies
nodes.summary: Asks the fast model for exactly three short replies as JSON.

nodes.name: Open reply with AI draft
nodes.summary: Clicking a reply opens the composer, which drafts a full reply from it.

nodes.name: Translate Email
nodes.summary: Detects the email's language and streams a translation into the user's language.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Opening a message in a foreign language, then clicking Translate

nodes.name: Detect language
nodes.summary: Uses a fast offline script-based guess, falling back to the model.

nodes.name: Stream translation
nodes.summary: Streams the subject and body translation with the translation model.

nodes.name: Add Event to Calendar
nodes.summary: Extracts the main event from an email and opens it as an .ics file.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks 'Add to calendar'

nodes.name: Extract event
nodes.summary: Has the model find the most important event, meeting, flight or deadline.

nodes.name: Serialize to iCalendar
nodes.summary: Serializes the event as an RFC 5545 VEVENT.

nodes.name: Write and open .ics
nodes.summary: Writes the .ics file and opens it in the calendar app.

nodes.name: Composing & Sending
nodes.summary: Writes and sends mail with local AI help (drafts, rewrites, subjects), an undo-send window, scheduled 'Send later' delivery, drafts and follow-up reminders when nobody replies.

businessRules: Every recipient address must be valid and at least one recipient is required
Sends wait for the undo-send delay; undo reopens the composer
Scheduled mail is only sent while the app is running; attachments are copied to an outbox
A failed scheduled send is put back and retried on the next 30-second tick
A follow-up reminder is cleared when a reply referencing the sent message arrives
crossDomainInteractions: Sends through MailService from Accounts & Mail Sync
Uses EmailAi writing features from AI Triage & Smart Inbox
Stores scheduled mail, follow-ups and contacts in Local Organization's UserData

nodes.name: AI-Assisted Compose
nodes.summary: Writes or reworks an email with the local writing model.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User uses the AI writer or AI toolbar in the composer

nodes.name: Prefill composer
nodes.summary: Prefills fields for new, reply, reply-all, forward, follow-up or a restored undo.

nodes.name: Run AI writing action
nodes.summary: Generic driver that saves the current text and streams the AI result into the body.

nodes.name: Generate draft text
nodes.summary: Streams a reply draft, new email from notes, rewrite or custom edit in the user's voice.

nodes.name: Clean draft
nodes.summary: Strips code fences and 'Here is…' preambles from model output.

nodes.name: Suggest subject
nodes.summary: Generates a short subject line from the body.

nodes.name: Send with Undo
nodes.summary: Validates and sends a message after an undo-send delay.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks Send or presses Cmd+Enter

nodes.name: Validate recipients
nodes.summary: Requires a recipient and checks all To/Cc/Bcc addresses.

nodes.name: Build final body
nodes.summary: Appends the signature and quoted history to the body.

nodes.name: Queue with undo window
nodes.summary: Holds the mail for the undo delay and shows an Undo toast.

nodes.name: Build MIME message
nodes.summary: Renders Markdown to HTML/plain, adds reply threading and attachments.

nodes.name: Send via SMTP
nodes.summary: Sends the message and saves it to Sent.

nodes.name: Learn contacts and set follow-up
nodes.summary: Learns recipients for autocomplete and records a follow-up reminder if requested.

nodes.name: Send Later
nodes.summary: Schedules a message and sends it when due during housekeeping.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User picks a 'Send later' time; delivered by the 30-second tick

nodes.name: Pick send time
nodes.summary: Shows the Send later dialog with preset times.

nodes.name: Queue scheduled mail
nodes.summary: Copies attachments to an outbox and stores the ScheduledMail.

nodes.name: Find due mail
nodes.summary: The 30-second tick finds scheduled messages whose time has come.

nodes.name: Send scheduled mail
nodes.summary: Builds and sends the mail, cleaning up attachments, or puts it back on failure.

nodes.name: Follow-Up Reminders
nodes.summary: Tracks sent mail that needs an answer and clears it when a reply arrives.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Follow-up chosen in composer; checked every 30 seconds

nodes.name: Choose follow-up delay
nodes.summary: User picks a follow-up delay in days in the composer.

nodes.name: Record follow-up
nodes.summary: After sending, stores a FollowUp keyed by Message-ID.

nodes.name: Clear on reply
nodes.summary: The tick removes follow-ups once an inbox message references them.

nodes.name: Dismiss manually
nodes.summary: User can dismiss a follow-up without waiting.

nodes.name: Local Organization
nodes.summary: Keeps the user's personal mail organization on the device: Remind-me snoozes, VIPs, blocked senders, muted threads, contacts and one-click unsubscribe.

businessRules: All organization data is local to this computer and persisted as one JSON blob
Snoozed messages are hidden from the inbox until due, then brought back unread on top
Blocked senders (exact address or @domain) go to Junk
Muted threads are marked read and archived unless flagged
VIP mail always shows
crossDomainInteractions: Rules run on every fetch from Accounts & Mail Sync
Snooze and unsubscribe controls are shown in Reading & AI Assistance
Stores Composing & Sending's scheduled mail and follow-ups

nodes.name: Remind Me (Snooze)
nodes.summary: Hides a message until a chosen time, then brings it back to the inbox.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User picks a 'Remind me' time; resurfaced by the 30-second tick

nodes.name: Pick remind time
nodes.summary: Offers presets or a custom date and time.

nodes.name: Store snooze
nodes.summary: Saves a Snooze keyed by the message and hides it from the inbox.

nodes.name: Check due snoozes
nodes.summary: The 30-second tick finds snoozes that are due.

nodes.name: Bring message back
nodes.summary: Fetches the message if needed, marks it unread and shows a reminder toast.

nodes.name: Block and Mute Rules
nodes.summary: Applies blocked-sender and muted-thread rules to incoming mail.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User blocks a sender or mutes a thread; rules re-run on every fetch

nodes.name: Block sender or mute thread
nodes.summary: Adds a sender to the block list or toggles muting for a thread.

nodes.name: Check blocked sender
nodes.summary: Matches the sender by exact address or @domain.

nodes.name: Apply rules to inbox
nodes.summary: Moves blocked mail to Junk and marks muted threads read and archives them.

nodes.name: Unsubscribe from Mailing List
nodes.summary: Leaves a mailing list through its List-Unsubscribe headers.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User clicks Unsubscribe in the reader

nodes.name: Parse List-Unsubscribe
nodes.summary: Finds the http(s) and mailto unsubscribe targets and one-click support.

nodes.name: Confirm with user
nodes.summary: Asks for confirmation in the reader.

nodes.name: Perform unsubscribe
nodes.summary: Uses one-click POST, else sends an unsubscribe email, else opens the web page.

nodes.name: Mark VIP Senders
nodes.summary: Keeps a local VIP list whose mail always shows in its own view.

domainMeta.entryPoint: User toggles the VIP star next to a sender

nodes.name: Toggle VIP
nodes.summary: Adds or removes the sender from the VIP list and saves.

nodes.name: Show VIP view
nodes.summary: The VIP view lists inbox mail from VIP senders.

edges.description: New mail triggers AI inbox sorting when auto-sort is on
Fetched mail is embedded into the semantic index; MailService runs server-side searches
Block and mute rules run on every fetched batch; snoozed mail is resurfaced from the server
Uses EmailAi to plan, rank and answer searches with the local model
Uses EmailAi for summaries, quick replies, translation and event extraction; shows the triage suspicious flag
Quick replies and reply/forward actions open the composer
Sends through the account's MailService over SMTP
Uses EmailAi writing features (drafts, rewrites, subjects)
Stores scheduled mail, follow-ups and learned contacts in UserData
Reader exposes Remind me, VIP, block and unsubscribe controls
